subject: Architecture
title: Stonehenge: Sacred Circle of Mystery
description: A short lesson to help you apply Stonehenge: Sacred Circle of Mystery.

hook.text: Stonehenge's giant stones were dragged 150 miles across Britain 5,000 years ago. Nobody fully knows why.

buildup.text: The bluestones came from Wales. Some weigh 4 tons. They were transported without wheels or metal tools.

discovery.text: The stones align with the sunrise on the summer solstice — Stonehenge was a giant astronomical calendar.

twist.text: Recent DNA analysis shows the builders were replaced by a new population. Their descendants don't live there.

climax.text: Cremated remains of 150 people were buried at Stonehenge — it may have been a cemetery for the elite.

punchline.text: 5,000 years later, we still argue about why they built it.

quiz.question: Where did Stonehenge's bluestones originate?
options: France, shipped across the English Channel
